To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the machine is not a metaphor for the human, and that the human is not a metaphor of the machine.
machine learning and artificial intelligence are not the same thing and that the latter is not a new religion.
the machine is not the model, but a tool.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the machine in society and the way it is perceived.
the question of how the human being is to understand the role of the machine in our lives, and in the world, in the context of the digital age.
the question of how the machine theology can be put to rest.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the machine is not a theology.
, in the context of the present work, machine theology refers to the belief in the possibility of the machine (in the sense of an automaton) to produce meaning.
the machine theology is a false god, which, in spite of all its achievements, cannot be the ultimate source of meaning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have to learn to live with machines that are better than we are at what they do.
the machine is a tool, not a theology, for human intelligence.
the digital computer, as the machine, is not a model of the mind, but a model of a mindless world.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the machine is not a substitute for the human, and that the human is not a machine.
we need to move beyond the deterministic theology of computation and embrace the complexity of living systems.
the digital computer is a useful tool, but it is not an adequate model for understanding the living world.
